architecture.rule: Derive PCB geometry from mainboard component packing, electrical routing, thermal needs, service access and the product chassis. Treat every display as a replaceable external peripheral.

display_interface.role: generic 15-pin Raspberry-Pi-style MIPI DSI host interface
display_interface.route_policy: Route DSI clock, lane 0 and lane 1. Keep the shared display I2C and the dedicated 3V3_DISPLAY_MODULE branch.
display_interface.placement_policy: Place J6 at a service-accessible board edge after the board outline and connector packing study. Do not assign display-relative XY coordinates.
display_interface.cable_policy: Select or qualify the FFC/adapter per supported display model. Type-B is proven for DSI506 but is not a universal board requirement.

each_supported_display_requires: the locked 15-pin electrical map or an explicit adapter
3.3 V startup, steady-state and transient current within the qualified J6 power branch budget
a validated DSI lane count, rate, pixel format and timing profile
a validated touch/controller I2C profile where used
a documented FFC contact orientation and assembly/service envelope

validated_profiles.mechanical_scope: display-specific cable/bracket/enclosure evidence only; never mainboard outline or mounting authority

outline_must_be_derived_from: complete footprint population and courtyard packing
board-owned chassis mounting pattern and edge clearances
power, USB, MIPI, SDIO, QSPI and audio routing feasibility
user connector cutouts plus mated cable/service envelopes
forbidden_as_outline_authority: DSI506-derived 128 x 84 x 30 mm enclosure screen
legacy JC4880 enclosure and mounting geometry
